title: Bands once hired for weddings and parties
summary: The interviewer notes bands used to play every wedding and christening; Clayton says he once turned work away but things are rough now.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: Yeah. I was gonna ask about some of the other old time days and the jobs you played, like, they tell me they used to have, every time they'd have a wedding party or a christening or a birthday or anything else, they'd have a band in the old days. That's right. And they don't do that now. They got a jukebox or nothing at all, radio.

That's right. They don't hide a band. I used to get so much work, though. I used to have to turn down some, either get a, you know, sub it out to some other band. I used to be going all the time. Things got rough here now.
